_comment: Supervisor config for the 20-vehicle sim, in METRES in TacFrame.
Note this differs from the Brain's defaults, which are in normalised
estimator units (a 1x1 box, 8 cm spacing) because the Brain flew a
Crazyflie-scale dataset. Same struct, same gate, different site.
max_cov_trace is the number Domain 1 is about. The anchored estimator
holds sigma around 6 cm/axis => trace ~0.007. A conventionally-pinned
estimator reports a comparable trace while being 1.16 m from truth, which
is exactly why this gate cannot be the only thing standing between a
drifting estimate and a commanded vehicle.
